entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE or network to detach from EPS services, non-EPS services, or both. Also used to disconnect from last PDN connection when EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management registered state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: Detach type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of detach procedure being performed.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not supported
entities.description: Condition where either UE or MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED state without PDN connection.

entities.name: USIM removal
entities.description: Condition triggered when USIM card is removed from the UE.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation
entities.description: Local deactivation of EPS bearer contexts without peer-to-peer signaling between UE and MME.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: NAS level mobility management congestion control timer.

entities.name: TIN storage in non-volatile memory
entities.description: UE stores Temporary Identity used in Next update (TIN) in non-volatile memory for subsequent attach procedure.

relations.description: Detach procedure is triggered when EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported.
Detach procedure uses detach type information element.
When detach is triggered by USIM removal, UE indicates 'switch off' in detach type IE.
Detach procedure for EPS services results in local deactivation of EPS bearer contexts.
UE stores TIN in non-volatile memory during detach procedure for subsequent attach.
UE can initiate detach procedure even when timer T3346 is running.
Detach procedure may be performed when UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state.
